low.intent: Fast composition, realtime review and silhouette decisions
low.texture_guidance: 0.5–2K by screen coverage; shared atlases where appropriate
low.geometry: Preserve openings and silhouette; instance repetitions; bake non-silhouette relief
low.audit: Check scale, normals, UVs, holes, grazing-angle silhouette and realtime draw calls

high.texture_guidance: 2–4K typical visible materials; calculate texel density rather than upscale everything
high.geometry: Bevel visible hard edges in physical units; use control loops and displacement selectively
high.audit: Inspect 100% crops, instances, fabric seams, reflection continuity and memory

very-high.intent: Closeups and hero details where high fails a measured crop
very-high.texture_guidance: 4–8K only for measured closeup demand; tiled/UDIM when supported
very-high.geometry: Keep editable control cages; render-time subdivision/displacement; proxy heavy assets
very-high.audit: Compare high vs very-high at final output size; retain extra cost only for visible improvement
